claim: operator sys_days() is a total function with no ok() guard, and the era arithmetic normalizes an out-of-range day to the first of the following month rather than rejecting it: 1900-02-29, which has ok() == false, maps to -25508, the same epoch day count as 1900-03-01, and 2023-02-29, also ok() == false, maps to 19417, the same count as 2023-03-01; the round trip therefore fails on exactly the two invalid samples of the E-14 set, 16 of 18 identical and 2 of 18 not. A port that rejects an invalid date where this one normalizes it is not behaviorally equivalent on this input class.
